game_title: Call Stack Tower – Snowdrift Barracks Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the firewood keeper ahead. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving stack_height that move the firewood keeper forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
